text.jp:
「普通」の家族の暮らしを手に入れるために
困難に立ち向かいながら成長するひたむきな少年
text.official_en:
A young boy comes of age as he fights to gain a
normal family life.
text.real_en:
A single-minded boy who faces hardship and grows
as he strives to obtain a 'normal' family life.

text.jp:
魂の渇きを癒すために強敵を求めて流離う
フォドラ十傑の血を継ぎし異邦人
text.official_en:
Hailing from Fódlan and heir to a legendary
blood lust, he roams, seeking the strongest foes.
text.real_en:
A foreigner descended from Fódlan's Ten Elites,
wandering in search of strong foes to quench his soul's thirst.

text.jp:
国家数百年にわたる悲願を果たすために戦う
勇猛果敢にして剛毅果断なサラミス王国の女王
text.official_en:
The dauntless queen of Saramis fights to fulfill
her people's long-held dream.
text.real_en:
The brave and resolute queen of Saramis fights to fulfill
her nation’s cherished ambition of several centuries.

text.jp:
魅惑の調べを憎しみの色に染めながら
仇を追って流離う美しき復讐の薔薇
text.official_en:
A rose seeks revenge, her searing songs colored
by deep-red hatred.

text.jp:
リベイラ村で父親と二人暮らしていた平凡な少年、カイ。
ある日故郷の村を訪れた神殿の騎士から「猶予期間」の終わりを告げられる。
物見遊山気分で同行を申し出た幼馴染たちと共に、訳が分からぬままに
帝都ダグシオンに向かうことになるのだが……
text.official_en:
Cai is a young boy living in Ribeira with his father. They are visited by a temple
knight who has come to tell Cai's father it's time to face punishment for
crimes committed before Cai's birth. Accompanied by his childhood friends,
Cai sets off for the imperial capital of Dagsion to find answers.
text.real_en:
Kai is a young boy living in Ribeira with his father. They are visited by a temple
knight who has come to tell Kai's father it's time to face punishment for
crimes committed before Kai's birth. Accompanied by his childhood friends,
Kai sets off for the imperial capital of Dagsion to find answers.

text.jp:
色々な者との交流を通じてカイは大きく成長してゆく。
数々の困難を乗り越えた果てに、ついに大剣闘祭の優勝を果たしたカイ。
母である女神アウロラと神威法王ソレルの間を取り持つことに成功すると、
カイは念願だった家族三人での平凡な暮らしを手に入れたのだった。
text.official_en:
Cai forges bonds with fighters who help him win the Heroic Games. He
arranges for his mother, the goddess Aurora, to meet with the Divine Sovereign
Solel, and at last Cai's wish to live an ordinary life with his parents is granted.
text.real_en:
Kai forges bonds with fighters who help him win the Heroic Games. He
arranges for his mother, the goddess Aurora, to meet with the Divine Sovereign
Sorell, and at last Kai's wish to live an ordinary life with his parents is granted.

text.jp:
ダグシオンの郊外に家を借り、家族で暮らしていたカイの元に
サラミス王国からの使者が訪れる。セオドラに対し絆を感じていたカイは、
巨大なダグザ帝国に対し戦いを挑もうとする彼女たちの力になるために、
サラミス王国の王都メガエラを目指し、出発するのだった。
text.official_en:
Cai is living with his parents in a rented house in the suburbs of Dagsion when
an envoy from Saramis arrives, saying Theodora needs Cai's help. Cai quickly
departs for Megaira, the capital of Saramis, to help Theodora challenge the
mighty Dagdan Empire.
text.real_en:
Kai is living with his parents in a rented house in the suburbs of Dagsion when
an envoy from Saramis arrives, saying Theodora needs Kai's help. Kai quickly
departs for Megaira, the capital of Saramis, to help Theodora challenge the
mighty Dagdan Empire.

text.jp:
セオドラとともに神威大帝ダグザを打倒したカイだったが、
巨竜の肉体を贄とした冥界の受肉と魔神バロールの復活が果たされてしまう。
絶体絶命の窮地に陥る中、出現した白い人物によって救われたカイは、
今や魔物の巣窟と化したダグシオンから辛くも脱出を果たすのだった。
text.official_en:
Cai helps Theodora defeat the Divine Emperor Dagda, but the huge dragon's
body is sacrificed to manifest the underworld and revive the demon god Balor.
A figure in white appears and saves Cai from certain death, and Cai manages
to escape the ravening hordes of undead overwhelming Dagsion.
text.real_en:
Kai helps Theodora defeat the Divine Emperor Dagda, but the huge dragon's
body is sacrificed to manifest the underworld and revive the demon god Balor.
A figure in white appears and saves Kai from certain death, and Kai manages
to escape the ravening hordes of undead overwhelming Dagsion.

text.jp:
フォドラ十傑の血を継ぎ、英雄の遺産のひとつ「魔剣アンスウェラー」の
使い手である美しき剣士ディートリヒ。乗り込んだ船が怪物に沈められた
ことによりダグザの地に漂着したディートリヒは、そこで大剣闘祭の存在を
耳にすると、己が魂の渇きに従い帝都ダグシオンを目指すのだった。
text.official_en:
Dietrich, an alluring swordsman descended from one of Fódlan's legendary 10
Elites, is shipwrecked in Dagda by a vast sea creature. With his Hero's Relic,
the fell blade Answerer, he follows his unquenchable thirst for battle to Dagsion
in hopes of entering the Heroic Games.

text.jp:
仲間たちとの絆は、ディートリヒの人間性に確実に変化をもたらしていた。
軍神マーズとの戦いの中、獣と化してでも戦い続けようとしたディートリヒ
を踏みとどまらせたのは「あなたは人間だ」というファビオの声だった。
軍神マーズはディートリヒを讃え、この地で最強の人間と称したのだった。
text.official_en:
The bonds Dietrich forges with his companions change him. In the midst of his
battle with Mars, the Bringer of War, moved by Fabio's words—"you are
human"—he resists assuming the form of a beast, instead ending the fight.
Impressed by his skill, Mars names him the strongest human in Dagda.

text.jp:
大剣闘祭が幕を閉じた後もダグシオンに滞在を続けるディートリヒの元に
サラミス王国からの使者が訪れる。復活した神威大帝ダグザに対し
刃を向ける行為に激しくそそられたディートリヒは喜んでこれを引き受けると
サラミス王国の王都メガエラを目指し、嬉々として出発するのだった。
text.official_en:
Dietrich, still in Dagsion after the conclusion of the Heroic Games, receives
an envoy from the kingdom of Saramis. Eager to face a resurrected Dagda
the Great, he swiftly departs for Megaira, the kingdom's capital.

text.jp:
セオドラとともに神威大帝ダグザを打倒したディートリヒだったが、
巨竜の肉体を贄とした冥界の受肉と魔神バロールの復活が果たされてしまう。
絶体絶命の窮地に陥る中、出現した白い人物によって救われたディートリヒは、
今や魔物の巣窟と化したダグシオンから辛くも脱出を果たすのだった。
text.official_en:
Alongside Theodora, Dietrich defeats the dragon Dagda the Great, but the
god is sacrificed to manifest the underworld and revive the demon god Balor.
A figure in white appears, saving Dietrich from certain death, and Dietrich
breaks free from the hellscape of Dagsion.

text.jp:
ザンジバル要塞での任務を終えて数年ぶりに王都メガエラへの帰還を
果たしたセオドラだったが、暗殺者によって父である国王を殺され、自らも
右腕を切り落とされてしまう。起死回生の道を模索するセオドラだったが……
果たして、サラミス王国の王座の行方は？
text.official_en:
Theodora returns to the royal capital of Megaira for the first time in
years after a tour of duty at Fort Zanbar—only for an assassin to slay her
father and take her right arm. Theodora searches for any path out of her
hopeless situation, fearful of what will become of the throne of Saramis.
text.real_en:
Theodora returns to the royal capital of Megaira for the first time in
years after a tour of duty at Zanzibar Fortress—only for an assassin to slay her
father and take her right arm. Theodora searches for any path out of her
hopeless situation, fearful of what will become of the throne of Saramis.

text.jp:
右腕の不安や、弟ダヤンの奇妙な動向など、懸案の尽きない状態で
大剣闘祭を戦い続けるセオドラだったが、ザンジバル要塞が陥落した
報を受け急遽帰国を決断する。セオドラは宿敵モーザと結託し反旗を翻した
ダヤンを討ち、緊迫した状況を収めることに成功するのだった。
text.official_en:
Amidst concerns about her arm, and her brother Dyan's strange behavior,
Theodora continues to fight in the Heroic Games. But when she receives word
of Fort Zanbar's fall, she returns home immediately. Finding that her brother
worked with the Mosa to overthrow her, she defeats Dyan to end his rebellion.
text.real_en:
Amidst concerns about her arm, and her brother Dayan's strange behavior,
Theodora continues to fight in the Heroic Games. But when she receives word
of Zanzibar Fortress's fall, she returns home immediately. Finding that her brother
worked with the Mosa to overthrow her, she defeats Dayan to end his rebellion.

text.jp:
ザンジバル要塞の戦いを制し、戦後処理に追われるセオドラのもとに
驚天動地の知らせがもたらされる。ついに復活を果たした神威大帝ダグザが
サラミス王国に対し宣戦を布告したというのである。セオドラはこれを受け
ダグシオンに攻めあがるべく、軍団に檄を飛ばすのだった。
text.official_en:
After her victory at Fort Zanbar, Theodora busies herself with post-battle
matters when astonishing news arrives: the Divine Emperor Dagda has been
revived and declared war on the kingdom of Saramis. In response, Theodora
mobilizes her allies, spurring them to march on Dagsion.
text.real_en:
After her victory at Zanzibar Fortress, Theodora busies herself with post-battle
matters when astonishing news arrives: the Divine Emperor Dagda has been
revived and declared war on the kingdom of Saramis. In response, Theodora
mobilizes her allies, spurring them to march on Dagsion.

text.jp:
ダグシオンに進撃し、ついに神威大帝ダグザを打倒したセオドラだったが、
巨竜の肉体を贄とした冥界の受肉と魔神バロールの復活が果たされてしまう。
絶体絶命の窮地に陥る中、出現した白い人物によって救われたセオドラは、
今や魔物の巣窟と化したダグシオンから辛くも脱出を果たすのだった。
text.official_en:
Theodora marches into Dagsion to deliver a final defeat to the Divine
Emperor, but the huge dragon's body is sacrificed to manifest the underworld
and revive the demon god Balor. A figure in white appears, saving Theodora
from certain death, and she escapes the undead hordes swarming over Dagsion.

text.jp:
恩師が死の際に残したマードル文書。そこに名を記された人物を追跡し
復讐を続けるレダは、旅の中で自分の父を手にかけた男の生存を知り、
その命を刈り取るためにダグシオン大剣闘祭に身を投じる。
レダの復讐の先に待つものとは！？
text.official_en:
Leda is on a quest for revenge, seeking to kill those named in a list left by her
mentor Mahdel before he died. After discovering that her father's murderer is
still alive, she enters the Heroic Games so that she may finally kill him.
There's no telling where this bloody journey may bring her.
text.real_en:
Leda is on a quest for revenge, seeking to kill those named in a list left by her
mentor Mardle before he died. After discovering that her father's murderer is
still alive, she enters the Heroic Games so that she may finally kill him.
There's no telling where this bloody journey may bring her.

text.jp:
大剣闘祭でベルトランを下したものの、レダは彼の命を奪わなかった。
真の敵が別におり、自分では歯が立たないほど巨大だと悟ったためだった。
レダは真相の解明を神威法王に委ねると、冥界に囚われた父の魂を救う
方法を探すために南方に旅立つことを仲間たちに打ち明けるのだった。
text.official_en:
Although Leda defeats Bertrand in the Heroic Games, she does not take his life.
She realizes her true enemy is someone else, whom she can't fight on her own.
Entrusting the investigation to the Divine Sovereign, Leda intends to travel
south and discover some way to save her father's soul from the underworld.

text.jp:
カーラ神殿に滞在しながら南方に向かう旅の支度を進めるレダのもとに、
サラミス王国からの使者が訪れる。神威大帝に強い反発を抱いたレダは
巨大なダグザ帝国に対し戦いを挑もうとするセオドラの力になるべく、
サラミス王国の王都メガエラを目指し、出発するのだった。
text.official_en:
At the temple of Kalla, Leda is preparing to travel, but her plans abruptly
change when an envoy from the kingdom of Saramis arrives. Leda's fierce
resentment for the Divine Emperor leads her to depart for Megaira, the
kingdom's capital, to help Theodora challenge the mighty Dagdan Empire.
text.real_en:
At the temple of Cara, Leda is preparing to travel, but her plans abruptly
change when an envoy from the kingdom of Saramis arrives. Leda's fierce
resentment for the Divine Emperor leads her to depart for Megaira, the
kingdom's capital, to help Theodora challenge the mighty Dagdan Empire.

text.jp:
セオドラとともに神威大帝ダグザを打倒したレダだったが、
巨竜の肉体を贄とした冥界の受肉と魔神バロールの復活が果たされてしまう。
絶体絶命の窮地に陥る中、出現した白い人物によって救われたレダは、
今や魔物の巣窟と化したダグシオンから辛くも脱出を果たすのだった。
text.official_en:
Alongside Theodora, Leda defeats Dagda the Great, but the huge dragon's
body is sacrificed to manifest the underworld and revive the demon god Balor.
A figure in white appears, saving Leda from certain death, and she escapes the
undead hordes swarming over Dagsion.

救世主<#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:02>

かつて地上を支配したものたちも、巨大な流れに飲み込まれてゆく。
冥界が地上に顕現する以前から、永劫に繰り返されてきた流転の定め。

text.official_en:
Even rulers of the world are seen swallowed by the darkness, but such is the
immutable law of flux governing humanity since before the underworld
manifested. As the war with the dead rages on, Fortuna tells <#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:02>

text.jp:
欺瞞をその身に纏いしかつての王に、傲慢にその心をとらえられし者、
冥将との戦いは、人の業そのものと向き合いにも似て、混迷を深めてゆく。
フォトナの口から語られた、神族すらも逃れられぬ滅びの定め。
それは限られた命の中で懸命に生きよという意味なのだと、彼女は言った。
text.official_en:
A former king cloaked in deceit, and a man whose heart is consumed with
pride... The chaos intensifies as the battles with the Brimstone Lords are akin to
confrontations with karma itself. Fortuna speaks of a destined end that even
the gods cannot escape and suggests that this spurs all to live life to its fullest.
text.real_en:
A former king cloaked in deceit, and a man whose heart is consumed with
pride... The chaos intensifies as the battles with the Nether Generals are akin to
confrontations with karma itself. Fotona speaks of a destined end that even
the gods cannot escape and suggests that this spurs all to live life to its fullest.

text.jp:
冥界の門を守る様々な冥将と、人の数だけ存在するそれぞれの業。
激戦を乗り越え、<#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:02>

More Brimstone Lords guard the gates of the underworld, each with
their own karma. After a series of difficult battles, <#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:02>
text.real_en:
More Nether Generals guard the gates of the underworld, each with
their own karma. After a series of difficult battles, <#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:02>

text.jp:
<DLG>カイは、動物と心を通わせることのできる、純粋で活発な少年です

通行不可な場所があるなど、行動範囲にある程度制限がありますが
各地に生息する様々な騎乗動物を「捕獲」して、味方に配備することや
「栽培」を行って作物を育て、素材を増やすことなどが可能です

そのほかにも、街にいる様々な人の悩みを解決して「人助け」したり
経験豊富な人物から「稽古」を受けて成長したりすることもできます
text.official_en:
<DLG>Cai is a pure-hearted, energetic boy who shares a bond with animals.

Since he's still a boy, he is not allowed to venture into some locales,
but he can gather materials, farm for crops, and capture ridable
animals for his companions to use in mounted combat.

By helping people in the city solve their problems, he will grow his
renown and receive mentoring from more experienced fighters.
text.real_en:
<DLG>Kai is a pure-hearted, energetic boy who shares a bond with animals.

Since he's still a boy, he is not allowed to venture into some locales,
but he can gather materials, farm for crops, and capture ridable
animals for his companions to use in mounted combat.

By helping people in the city solve their problems, he will grow his
renown and receive mentoring from more experienced fighters.

text.jp:
<DLG>ディートリヒは、逸楽のために戦いを求める恐るべき剣士です

魔剣の「刃鳴り」の力で付近に潜む敵を見つけ出し、戦いを挑めるほか
「兇戦士」と呼ばれる者たちから挑戦状が届き、決闘に勝利することで
強力な「秘伝の戦技」を己のものとすることができます

また、それら戦いの中で身につけた技を「戦技強化」したり、
仲間に「伝授」することで戦力を強化していくことが可能です
text.official_en:
<DLG>Dietrich, a fearsome swordsman, seeks battle for pleasure.

He can challenge the strongest of wandering warriors by using his fell
blade to locate them and may also be challenged by foes from across
the land. By defeating them, he can make their combat arts his own.

Once obtained in battle, these combat arts may be strengthened or
taught to his comrades at the temple, allowing him to bolster his clan.

text.jp:
<DLG>セオドラは、サラミス王国の女王で“鉄の女”の異名を持つ女傑です

訪れた村や町で「兵士募集」することで、自らの旗下に
「軍団兵」として迎え入れ、それらを仲間に配備することで、
戦力の向上に加え、様々な「計略」を使用させられるようになります

さらに軍団兵を各地に「派兵」して探索させれば、効率よく素材を
集めることができ、戦闘以外の場面でも大いなる恩恵をもたらします
text.official_en:
<DLG>Theodora, known by some as the Iron Bastion, is the queen of Saramis.

She can recruit soldiers from settlements she visits to bring them under
her banner as battalions. Assigning a battalion to a unit increases
their power in battle and allows the use of their special gambits.

She can also deploy battalions to locations on the map to gather
resources for her, allowing them to aid the queen outside of combat.

text.jp:
<DLG>レダは、“カエルスの薔薇”の称号を持つ、芸術の才能に長けた女性です

依頼を受けて、酒場や各地の村や町で「興行」を行うことで
新たな「呪歌」を身につけ、戦闘に役立てることができます
また、特別な兵種「踊り子」の資格を得ることも可能です

それ以外にも、「秘密のスポット」の情報を耳にしたり、
様々な効果を持つ「飲み物」を購入したりすることができます
text.official_en:
<DLG>Leda, who holds the title of Rose of Caelus, excels in the arts.

By accepting quests and performing at local taverns, she can learn
new spellsongs, as well as gain certification in the dancer class.

Moreover, she has access to purchasing special drinks that grant
various benefits, and she can learn about hidden locations.
